date_display_zh: 2026 年 4 月 20 日·星期一
tagline_zh: 由 AI 為你策展，專屬早晨讀物

articles.title_zh: OpenAI發表生命科學模型 GPT-Rosalind，瞄準藥物研發與實驗推理
articles.title_en: OpenAI Unveils GPT-Rosalind for Drug Discovery and Life Sciences Research
articles.lede_zh: OpenAI推出面向生命科學的專用語言模型 GPT-Rosalind，主打化學、生物學、蛋白質工程與實驗設計等高門檻研究任務。若其在實際研發流程中維持評測優勢，將有望把生成式 AI 從通用助理推進到產業專用研究平台。
articles.lede_en: OpenAI has introduced GPT-Rosalind, a domain-specific language model tailored for chemistry, biology, protein engineering, and experimental design. If its benchmark gains translate into production workflows, the release could move generative AI beyond general assistants and into specialized R&D platforms.
bullets_zh: 模型鎖定藥物發現、轉譯醫學與生命科學研究流程
OpenAI稱其在多項科學推理與實驗設計評測中優於GPT-5系列與部分競品
已透過ChatGPT、Codex與API提供研究預覽，並附生命科學工具外掛
bullets_en: The model targets drug discovery, translational medicine, and broader life sciences workflows
OpenAI says it outperforms GPT-5 variants and some rivals on scientific reasoning and experiment-design benchmarks
It is available in research preview via ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, with add-ons for scientific tools

articles.title_zh: Anthropic推出 Claude Design，將生成式 AI 延伸至簡報、網頁與原型設計
articles.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Design for Slides, Web Pages, and Prototyping
articles.lede_zh: Anthropic公布研究預覽版 Claude Design，試圖把 Claude 從文字與程式生成，進一步延伸到視覺設計與產品原型工作流。這項產品若能順利串接企業設計系統與既有工具，將有機會成為知識工作者與產品團隊的新型 AI 入口。
articles.lede_en: Anthropic has announced Claude Design in research preview, extending Claude from text and code generation into visual design and product prototyping workflows. If it integrates smoothly with enterprise design systems and third-party tools, it could become a new AI entry point for product and knowledge teams.
bullets_zh: 可生成簡報、一頁式文件、登入頁、社群素材與互動式原型
支援讀取企業 codebase、設計檔與品牌元素，建立一致的設計系統
鎖定Claude Pro、Max、Team與Enterprise訂閱用戶逐步開放
bullets_en: It can generate slides, one-pagers, landing pages, social assets, and interactive prototypes
The system can read codebases, design files, and brand elements to build a consistent design system
Anthropic is rolling it out to Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise subscribers

articles.title_zh: 微軟收購財務 AI 新創 Fintool，強化 Microsoft 365 代理人布局
articles.title_en: Microsoft Acquires Finance AI Startup Fintool to Bolster Microsoft 365 Agents
articles.lede_zh: 微軟收購專攻財報分析與研究報告生成的 Fintool，進一步強化 Microsoft 365 在垂直領域 AI 代理人的落地能力。這筆交易顯示大型平台正加速吸納小型專業模型團隊，以補足通用模型在準確性與工作流深度上的缺口。
articles.lede_en: Microsoft has acquired Fintool, a startup focused on financial statement analysis and research generation, to strengthen vertical AI agent capabilities in Microsoft 365. The deal highlights how major platforms are buying specialized teams to close accuracy and workflow gaps left by general-purpose models.
bullets_zh: Fintool主打投資研究、財報分析與Office工作流整合
產品已可在背景執行模型建構、簡報製作與報告撰寫
反映企業AI競爭正從聊天介面轉向專業代理人
bullets_en: Fintool focuses on investment research, financial analysis, and Office workflow integration
Its product can already run models, build slides, and draft reports in the background
The move shows enterprise AI competition shifting from chat interfaces to specialized agents

articles.title_zh: 世界模型熱度升高，楊立昆與李飛飛陣營募資總額逼近10億美元
articles.title_en: World Model Startups Backed by Yann LeCun and Fei-Fei Li Approach $1 Billion in Funding
articles.lede_zh: 世界模型再度成為 AI 投資焦點，兩大學術與產業陣營相繼吸引大額資金。對工程團隊而言，這不僅是資本市場訊號，也意味著多模態環境理解、模擬與代理決策能力可能進入新一輪產品化周期。
articles.lede_en: World models are again becoming a major AI investment theme, with ventures tied to Yann LeCun and Fei-Fei Li drawing substantial funding. For engineering teams, the capital surge signals that multimodal environment understanding, simulation, and agent decision-making may be entering a new product cycle.
bullets_zh: 世界模型被視為通往具環境理解能力AI的重要路線
資金流向顯示市場看好模擬、機器人與代理系統的中長期應用
後續關鍵將是從研究敘事走向可驗證商業成果
bullets_en: World models are seen as a key path toward AI systems with stronger environmental understanding
Funding momentum suggests investor confidence in simulation, robotics, and agentic systems
The next test will be whether the research vision can turn into measurable business outcomes

articles.title_zh: Claude Token Counter新增模型比較，提供開發者更細緻的成本估算
articles.title_en: Claude Token Counter Adds Model Comparisons for Finer-Grained Cost Planning
articles.lede_zh: Simon Willison介紹 Claude Token Counter 新增模型比較功能，讓開發者可更直接評估不同 Claude 模型的 token 消耗差異。在代理式工作流與長上下文應用快速成長之際，成本觀測工具正成為模型選型的必要配備。
articles.lede_en: Simon Willison highlighted a new model comparison feature in Claude Token Counter, giving developers a more direct way to estimate token usage across Claude models. As agentic workflows and long-context applications expand, cost observability is becoming essential for model selection.
bullets_zh: 可比較不同Claude模型對同一輸入內容的token計算結果
有助於預估推論成本、上下文壓力與應用架構設計
適合建置多模型路由與企業級預算控管
bullets_en: The tool compares how different Claude models count tokens for the same input
It helps estimate inference costs, context pressure, and application design trade-offs
The feature is useful for multi-model routing and enterprise budget controls

articles.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.6與4.7系統提示詞差異曝光，凸顯模型行為治理的重要性
articles.title_en: Changes Between Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 System Prompts Highlight Model Governance
articles.lede_zh: 系統提示詞往往是大型模型行為邊界的隱形控制層。Simon Willison整理 Claude Opus 4.6 與 4.7 的系統提示變動，對企業導入者而言，這類差異有助理解模型升級後的風險、能力與輸出風格變化。
articles.lede_en: System prompts often serve as the hidden control layer for large model behavior. Simon Willison's review of changes between Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 offers enterprise users a clearer view of how upgrades can alter risk posture, capabilities, and output style.
bullets_zh: 系統提示詞變更可能直接影響模型回應策略與安全邊界
企業在升級模型版本時需納入行為回歸測試
也反映封閉模型產品在透明度上的持續爭議
bullets_en: System prompt changes can directly affect response strategy and safety boundaries
Enterprises need behavioral regression testing when upgrading model versions
The analysis also underscores ongoing transparency concerns around closed models

articles.title_zh: 個人 AI 走向無頭化架構，工具鏈與介面正加速解耦
articles.title_en: Personal AI Is Moving Toward Headless Architectures as Tools and Interfaces Decouple
articles.lede_zh: Simon Willison提出「Headless everything for personal AI」觀察，指出個人 AI 工具正從單一聊天介面轉向可被多端調用的後端能力。對開發者與產品團隊而言，這意味未來競爭重點可能不再只是模型本身，而是可組裝、可重用、可被代理調度的服務層。
articles.lede_en: Simon Willison argues that personal AI tools are shifting from single chat interfaces toward reusable backend capabilities that can be invoked across surfaces. For developers and product teams, that suggests the next competitive layer may be service composition and agent orchestration rather than the model alone.
bullets_zh: AI能力與前端介面分離，有利多端整合與自動化調度
更貼近Agent化應用、CLI工具與工作流自動化需求
也可能改變個人知識管理與本地部署產品設計
bullets_en: Separating AI capabilities from front-end interfaces enables cross-surface integration and automation
The pattern aligns with agentic applications, CLI tools, and workflow orchestration
It may also reshape personal knowledge tools and local deployment products

articles.title_zh: 主動式代理 AI 成本壓力浮現，Token 消耗可達傳統互動數十倍
articles.title_en: Agentic AI Faces a Cost Reckoning as Token Use Soars Far Beyond Traditional Chats
articles.lede_zh: 隨著主動式代理 AI 興起，業者正面臨一個更務實的問題：模型越自主，推論成本也往往越高。報導指出，代理式工作流的 token 消耗可能是傳統問答介面的數十倍，將直接影響 SaaS 定價、單位經濟與部署策略。
articles.lede_en: As agentic AI gains momentum, companies are confronting a more practical issue: greater autonomy often comes with much higher inference costs. Reports suggest token usage in agentic workflows can run dozens of times above traditional chat interactions, with direct consequences for SaaS pricing and unit economics.
bullets_zh: Agent執行規劃、工具呼叫與反覆推理會顯著放大token成本
成本結構將影響新創公司的毛利與商業模式可行性
企業導入需更重視模型路由、快取與任務分級
bullets_en: Planning, tool use, and iterative reasoning can sharply increase token consumption in agents
The cost profile could pressure startup margins and business model viability
Enterprises will need stronger model routing, caching, and task-tiering strategies

articles.title_zh: 軟銀獨賣 Natural AI Phone，手機入口開始押注全能代理人
articles.title_en: SoftBank Bets on Full-Stack Agents With Exclusive Natural AI Phone Launch
articles.lede_zh: Natural AI Phone以「一鍵啟動全能 AI 代理」為賣點，反映智慧型手機產業正重新定義下一代使用者介面。若代理式操作能穿透 App 邊界，將對行動平台、生態治理與開發者分潤帶來深遠影響。
articles.lede_en: Natural AI Phone is being marketed around one-tap access to a general-purpose AI agent, reflecting a broader effort to redefine the smartphone interface. If agent-driven actions can break through app silos, the shift could have major implications for mobile platforms, ecosystem control, and developer economics.
bullets_zh: 核心訴求是以AI代理取代傳統App導向操作流程
代表終端裝置廠商開始把Agent當成作業系統層級能力
後續關鍵在權限治理、跨App執行與隱私保護
bullets_en: The product aims to replace app-centric interactions with agent-driven workflows
It signals that device vendors are treating agents as an operating system-level capability
The next challenges will center on permissions, cross-app execution, and privacy

articles.title_zh: Google Sheets 可直接以 SQL 連接 Datasette，資料查詢工作流更貼近分析現場
articles.title_en: Google Sheets Can Now Query Datasette With SQL Functions
articles.lede_zh: Simon Willison展示將 Datasette 與 Google Sheets 以 SQL 函數串接的方法，讓試算表可直接成為資料查詢與分享介面。這類輕量整合對資料工程與內部工具團隊特別有吸引力，因為它能在不增加複雜 BI 系統的情況下擴大資料可用性。
articles.lede_en: Simon Willison demonstrated a way to connect Datasette with Google Sheets using SQL functions, turning spreadsheets into a direct query and sharing surface. The lightweight integration is especially compelling for data and internal tools teams that want broader access without deploying a full BI stack.
bullets_zh: 把試算表變成可直接查詢資料集的前端介面
降低非工程人員取用結構化資料的門檻
適合內部報表、自助分析與輕量資料產品場景
bullets_en: The approach turns spreadsheets into a front end for querying datasets
It lowers the barrier for non-engineers to access structured data
The workflow suits internal reporting, self-service analytics, and lightweight data products

articles.title_zh: Vercel證實四月資安事件，雲端開發平台供應鏈風險再受檢視
articles.title_en: Vercel Confirms April Security Incident, Renewing Scrutiny of Cloud Dev Platform Risk
articles.lede_zh: Vercel證實發生四月資安事件，外部報導則指出攻擊者聲稱取得並販售資料。對依賴託管平台與 CI/CD 服務的開發團隊來說，這起事件再次提醒，雲端開發平台已成為高價值供應鏈攻擊目標。
articles.lede_en: Vercel has confirmed an April security incident, while outside reporting says attackers are claiming to sell stolen data. For teams relying on hosted platforms and CI/CD services, the case is another reminder that cloud development vendors have become high-value supply chain targets.
bullets_zh: 事件牽動託管、部署與開發者帳號等敏感資產風險
受影響企業需重新盤點第三方平台權限與金鑰管理
也凸顯SaaS平台事件揭露與客戶通知流程的重要性
bullets_en: The incident raises concerns around hosting, deployment pipelines, and developer account exposure
Affected organizations may need to revisit third-party permissions and secret management
The case also highlights the importance of disclosure and customer notification practices

articles.title_zh: Notion公共頁面疑洩編輯者信箱，協作型 SaaS 的隱私邊界再受質疑
articles.title_en: Notion Public Pages Reportedly Exposed Editors’ Email Addresses
articles.lede_zh: 社群通報指出，Notion公共頁面可能外洩所有編輯者電子郵件地址，突顯協作型 SaaS 在分享機制上的隱私風險。對企業而言，這類設計瑕疵不僅涉及個資保護，也可能擴大社交工程攻擊面。
articles.lede_en: Community reports suggest that Notion public pages exposed the email addresses of all editors, underscoring privacy risks in collaborative SaaS sharing models. For enterprises, such design flaws can affect both personal data protection and social engineering exposure.
bullets_zh: 問題核心在公開分享機制與權限設計細節
外洩聯絡資訊可能提高釣魚與定向攻擊風險
企業需重新評估知識庫與外部分享頁面的資料最小化原則
bullets_en: The issue centers on public sharing behavior and permission design
Exposed contact details can increase phishing and targeted attack risk
Organizations should review data minimization practices for public knowledge pages

articles.title_zh: Claude Desktop遭指安裝未文件化瀏覽器擴充元件，AI桌面工具透明度受關注
articles.title_en: Claude Desktop Accused of Installing Undocumented Browser Extensions
articles.lede_zh: 有研究者指出，Claude Desktop會為Chrome等瀏覽器安裝未文件化擴充元件，引發使用者對權限、透明度與預設行為的疑慮。對快速擴張中的 AI 客戶端市場而言，產品便利性與可審計性之間的平衡正變得更重要。
articles.lede_en: A researcher claims Claude Desktop installs undocumented browser extensions for Chrome and other browsers, raising questions about permissions, transparency, and default behavior. For the fast-growing AI client market, the balance between convenience and auditability is becoming more critical.
bullets_zh: 爭議聚焦在安裝流程是否充分告知與取得明確同意
瀏覽器層權限涉及資料擷取、帳號安全與企業控管政策
AI桌面應用可能面臨更高的合規與資安審查
bullets_en: The controversy focuses on whether installation behavior was clearly disclosed and consented to
Browser-level permissions touch on data access, account safety, and enterprise policy control
AI desktop apps may face tighter compliance and security scrutiny

articles.title_zh: 記憶體短缺恐延續至2027年，AI帶動HBM排擠效應持續擴大
articles.title_en: Global Memory Shortage May Last Until 2027 as AI Demand Crowds Out Supply
articles.lede_zh: 在 AI 伺服器對 HBM 需求急升下，通用型 DRAM 供給正遭排擠，市場預估記憶體短缺可能延續到 2027 年。這不僅影響資料中心擴建，也將波及邊緣裝置、本地 AI 與整體硬體成本結構。
articles.lede_en: With AI servers driving surging demand for HBM, supply for commodity DRAM is being squeezed, and shortages may persist into 2027. The impact extends beyond data center expansion to edge devices, local AI deployment, and broader hardware cost structures.
bullets_zh: 三星、SK海力士與美光將產能優先轉向HBM
PC與手機用記憶體供給受壓，價格持續攀升
對AI伺服器、終端裝置與企業採購形成連鎖效應
bullets_en: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron are prioritizing HBM capacity
Supply for PC and smartphone memory is under pressure, pushing prices higher
The shortage creates knock-on effects for AI servers, end devices, and enterprise procurement

articles.title_zh: 三星停止LPDDR4系列接單，記憶體世代切換加速
articles.title_en: Samsung Stops Taking Orders for LPDDR4 as Memory Transition Accelerates
articles.lede_zh: 三星停止接受 LPDDR4 與 LPDDR4X 新訂單，並規劃於 2027 年正式停產，顯示記憶體產業正加快資源轉向新世代產品。對裝置製造商與嵌入式系統開發者來說，這將帶來 BOM 成本、供貨週期與相容性調整壓力。
articles.lede_en: Samsung has stopped taking new orders for LPDDR4 and LPDDR4X and plans to phase them out by 2027, signaling a faster industry shift toward newer memory generations. For device makers and embedded system developers, the move raises pressure around BOM costs, supply timelines, and compatibility planning.
bullets_zh: 舊世代記憶體產品逐步退場，供應策略明顯轉向
可能加速終端裝置平台升級與庫存重整
與AI需求帶動的整體記憶體緊張局勢相互疊加
bullets_en: Older memory generations are being phased out as suppliers redirect strategy
The change may accelerate device platform upgrades and inventory adjustments
It compounds broader market tightness already driven by AI demand

articles.title_zh: 黃仁勳示警華為晶片若先承載DeepSeek，美國AI競爭恐受壓
articles.title_en: Jensen Huang Warns Huawei-Backed DeepSeek Deployment Would Hurt U.S. AI Position
articles.lede_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳警告，若 DeepSeek 等高影響力模型優先在華為晶片上擴張，可能削弱美國在 AI 基礎設施與生態競爭中的優勢。此番言論凸顯模型、晶片與地緣政治之間已形成更緊密的戰略連動。
articles.lede_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has warned that if influential models such as DeepSeek scale first on Huawei chips, the U.S. could lose ground in AI infrastructure and ecosystem competition. The comments underscore how models, chips, and geopolitics are now tightly intertwined.
bullets_zh: AI競爭已從模型能力延伸到晶片平台與供應鏈主導權
DeepSeek成為觀察中國AI軟硬整合能力的重要指標
台灣半導體與伺服器供應鏈將持續受此格局牽動
bullets_en: AI competition now extends beyond models to chip platforms and supply chain control
DeepSeek has become a key indicator of China's software-hardware integration capacity
Taiwan's semiconductor and server supply chains remain closely exposed to this rivalry

articles.title_zh: IMF估五年後台灣人均GDP可望領先南韓，半導體整合力成關鍵支撐
articles.title_en: IMF Sees Taiwan’s GDP Per Capita Overtaking South Korea, Backed by Semiconductor Strength
articles.lede_zh: IMF預估，未來五年台灣人均 GDP 可望進一步拉開與南韓差距，反映半導體產業與相關供應鏈的高附加價值效應持續發酵。對本地科技主管而言，這不只是宏觀數字，更代表台灣在全球 AI 基礎設施版圖中的戰略位置正持續上升。
articles.lede_en: The IMF expects Taiwan's GDP per capita to widen its lead over South Korea over the next five years, reflecting the continuing high-value impact of the semiconductor sector and its supply chain. For local tech leaders, the forecast points to Taiwan's rising strategic role in the global AI infrastructure map.
bullets_zh: 半導體與AI供應鏈持續推升台灣整體經濟表現
高階製造與系統整合能力成為主要競爭優勢
有助強化台灣在全球科技投資與人才市場的吸引力
bullets_en: Semiconductors and AI-related supply chains continue to lift Taiwan's economic performance
Advanced manufacturing and system integration remain core competitive strengths
The outlook could strengthen Taiwan's appeal in global tech investment and talent markets

articles.title_zh: Cadence與NVIDIA擴大合作，代理AI與數位孿生加速半導體與AI工廠設計
articles.title_en: Cadence and Nvidia Expand Partnership Around Agentic AI and Digital Twins
articles.lede_zh: Cadence與NVIDIA擴大策略合作，將代理 AI 與數位孿生導入半導體設計與 AI 工廠流程，顯示 EDA 與製造模擬正進入更高自動化階段。對晶片與資料中心產業而言，這類整合有望縮短設計迭代時間，並改善複雜系統的建置效率。
articles.lede_en: Cadence and Nvidia are expanding their strategic partnership to bring agentic AI and digital twins into semiconductor design and AI factory workflows, signaling a new level of automation in EDA and manufacturing simulation. For chip and data center industries, the integration could shorten design cycles and improve deployment efficiency in complex systems.
bullets_zh: 合作焦點涵蓋EDA、數位孿生與AI工廠設計流程
代理AI可望協助複雜系統規劃、模擬與最佳化
反映AI基礎設施競爭正往設計工具鏈上游延伸
bullets_en: The partnership spans EDA, digital twins, and AI factory design workflows
Agentic AI could help with planning, simulation, and optimization of complex systems
The move shows AI infrastructure competition extending upstream into design toolchains

articles.title_zh: SK海力士量產192GB SOCAMM2，為NVIDIA Vera Rubin平台備戰
articles.title_en: SK hynix Starts Mass Production of 192GB SOCAMM2 for Nvidia’s Vera Rubin Platform
articles.lede_zh: SK海力士啟動 192GB SOCAMM2 量產，對應 NVIDIA 下一代 Vera Rubin 平台需求，顯示 AI 記憶體封裝與模組化路線持續升級。這項進展將直接影響高密度伺服器設計、系統功耗與整機供應鏈節奏。
articles.lede_en: SK hynix has begun mass production of 192GB SOCAMM2 memory for Nvidia's upcoming Vera Rubin platform, underscoring continued advances in AI memory packaging and modular design. The development has direct implications for dense server architecture, power efficiency, and system-level supply chains.
bullets_zh: 新模組瞄準下一代AI伺服器平台的高密度需求
記憶體設計成為AI系統性能與能耗關鍵變數
台灣伺服器與零組件供應鏈可望受惠
bullets_en: The module targets high-density requirements in next-generation AI server platforms
Memory architecture is becoming a critical variable in AI performance and power use
Taiwan's server and component supply chains could benefit from the ramp

articles.title_zh: 本地端AI需求升溫，蘋果硬體與服務商業模式可能同步調整
articles.title_en: Rising Local AI Demand Could Reshape Apple’s Hardware and Services Model
articles.lede_zh: 隨著本地端 AI 推論需求升高，市場開始關注蘋果是否將重新調整裝置規格、晶片配置與服務策略。若 AI 體驗逐步轉向端側執行，終端硬體能力將再次成為平台競爭核心。
articles.lede_en: As demand for on-device AI inference grows, attention is turning to whether Apple will rethink device specs, chip allocation, and service strategy. If AI experiences shift increasingly to the edge, endpoint hardware capability could once again become the center of platform competition.
bullets_zh: 本地推論有助隱私保護、延遲控制與離線可用性
將帶動記憶體、NPU與終端算力規格升級
也可能改變AI服務的收費與分發模式
bullets_en: On-device inference can improve privacy, latency, and offline availability
The shift would drive upgrades in memory, NPUs, and endpoint compute capacity
It may also change how AI services are priced and distributed
